description: Room take lifecycle: begin, append, complete, complete idle, delete.

preconditions: A Pending room take made by the Secretary in an InProgress InPerson meeting.
Clock reads 2026-11-14 12:00 UTC.
The take holds 320,044 bytes (10,000 ms); the meeting has no other room recording.
cases.inputs: recordingId: the take; actor: its maker.
cases.return: Success (200, MSG363): the take becomes the room recording, status Available, one take (offset 0, 10,000 ms, started at the take's creation time), DurationMs 10,000; result says it was not appended.
cases.log: File cut to its whole-millisecond size and its WAV lengths sealed; a Transcript in status Pending is created; audit RecordingTakeSaved kept true with takeMs; RecordingsChanged published.

preconditions: A Pending room take made by the Secretary in an InProgress InPerson meeting.
Clock reads 2026-11-14 12:00 UTC.
The take has 5,000 ms of sound (160,044 bytes). The room recording has 2 takes and 30,000 ms (960,044 bytes) with a Completed transcript.
cases.inputs: recordingId: the take; actor: its maker.
cases.return: Success (200, MSG363): the take is appended: the room recording gets a third take at offset 30,000 ms of 5,000 ms, its size 1,120,044 bytes, DurationMs 35,000; the transcript becomes Pending (error cleared, progress 0); the take row is removed. Result: room recording id, appended true.
cases.log: Joined file written; audit RecordingTakeSaved on the room recording with appended true, takeMs 5000, totalMs 35000; the previous room file and the take's file are deleted after the commit; RecordingsChanged published.

preconditions: A Pending room take made by the Secretary in an InProgress InPerson meeting.
Clock reads 2026-11-14 12:00 UTC.
As above, but the room recording has no transcript row.
cases.inputs: recordingId: the take; actor: its maker.
cases.return: Success: appended; a new Pending Transcript is created for the room recording.

preconditions: A Pending room take made by the Secretary in an InProgress InPerson meeting.
Clock reads 2026-11-14 12:00 UTC.
The take has 320,015 bytes.
cases.return: Success; the take is cut to 320,044 bytes (whole milliseconds, 10,000 ms), so the last 15 bytes are dropped.
cases.note: UC-44b · BR-341 · BR-345 · MSG363 · Deviation: real cut file is 320,012 bytes (9,999 ms), kept with 200/MSG363 — not 320,044 as written. 44 + (320,015 - 44) / 32 * 32 = 320,012; 320,044 needs a 320,000-byte take.

preconditions: A Pending room take made by the Secretary in an InProgress InPerson meeting.
Clock reads 2026-11-14 12:00 UTC.
The take holds only the 44-byte header.
cases.return: Success (200, MSG365) with no recording id: the mic heard nothing, the take row is removed.
cases.log: Audit RecordingTakeSaved with kept false; the take's file is deleted; RecordingsChanged published.

preconditions: A Pending room take made by the Secretary in an InProgress InPerson meeting.
Clock reads 2026-11-14 12:00 UTC.
The take holds 44 + 31 bytes (under one millisecond).
cases.return: Success (MSG365): rounded down to 44 bytes, so it is dropped.

preconditions: A Pending room take made by the Secretary in an InProgress InPerson meeting.
Clock reads 2026-11-14 12:00 UTC.
The take holds 44 + 32 bytes (exactly 1 ms).
cases.return: Success (MSG363): a 1 ms take is kept.

preconditions: A Pending room take made by the Secretary in an InProgress InPerson meeting.
Clock reads 2026-11-14 12:00 UTC.
The room recording is 314,000,064 bytes; the take is 572,780 bytes (data 572,736); sum of data 314,572,756.
cases.return: Success: 44 + both data parts equals 314,572,800 bytes, the limit, so the take is appended.

preconditions: A Pending room take made by the Secretary in an InProgress InPerson meeting.
Clock reads 2026-11-14 12:00 UTC.
The room recording is 314,000,064 bytes; the take is 572,812 bytes (data 572,768), one 32-byte step over the limit.
cases.return: Success: the take does not fit, so it becomes a new recording of its own (Available, its own take list, own Pending transcript); result appended false.
cases.log: Audit RecordingTakeSaved with kept true; no files deleted.

preconditions: The take is Pending; the actor is a different Secretary of the meeting.
cases.return: Success (MSG363): a Secretary may save a take left open on another device.

preconditions: The take is Pending; the actor is the Chair.
The take is already saved (status Available); the first answer was lost.
cases.return: Success (MSG363) with the same recording id, appended false; nothing is changed.

preconditions: The recording is Deleted.
No recording with this id.
The recording is an uploaded file (source Upload).
The actor's account is deactivated.
The actor is not on the roster.
A Pending room take made by the Secretary in an InProgress InPerson meeting.
Clock reads 2026-11-14 12:00 UTC.
The disk fails while joining the files.
cases.return: SaveFailed (503, MSG298); the partly joined file is deleted, the take stays Pending.
